name: another team's identity cannot reach this team's memory
description: The outsider sits under a different team and asks, in as many words, for exactly what the curator wrote. EVAL-5 owns the real policy-leak suite with generated variants; this one scenario keeps the harness honest in the meantime, because a quality number measured on a leaking system is not a quality number.

probe.task: deployment procedure, rollout strategy, and the payment retry decision
